description:
Outcome: The coordinator maintains the 40 plots, household identities, season dates and previous-season holdings needed for allocation, from brief.md / Background and Rules.
Scope: Persistent registry and migrations, coordinator setup forms, current and historical holdings, local timezone and season dates. Excludes: grid positions and map layout (T-014), self-service household merges and bulk imports.
Acceptance: Exactly 40 stable unique plot records; explicit March–October season dates; only coordinator can change registry and prior holdings; at most one allocation per household-season and one per plot-season, enforced atomically.
Behaviour: Reject invalid dates and duplicate allocations with clear accessible validation; empty/loading/failure/retry states preserve entered values. Unauthorized writes fail.
Verification: Model, role and form tests, including concurrent allocation constraint tests. Prerequisites: T-001 foundation and T-003 access. Assumptions: one verified email represents a household, with coordinator-managed identity corrections and previous-season records.
title: Garden registry
